generator.program.note: The quillworts' own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: a rosette of quills from a corm-like stem, no strobilus.

appearance.note: Quills drawn as narrow strap pieces, tapering at the tip.

rules.note: What the program's basal_length means: one quill's length.

generator.params.basal_length.why: A quillwort's leaves are its basal leaves, drawn as long as its flora gives them.

traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Isoetaceae and Isoetes: rosette plants, most of them aquatic, a few terrestrial and deciduous; leaves more or less linear, flat to round in section, tapering to the tip and spoon-shaped at the base, rising from a corm-like stem; the sporangia sit in the bases of the leaves, not in cones.
